description: Harmful, controlling, or threatening content packaged as joke/banter/lol. Mechanism: makes the statement deniable ('just joking') while still landing.

description: Downplaying the severity of behaviour: 'just', 'only a bit', 'overreacting'

description: Direct denial of events that occurred

description: Attributing perpetrator's conduct to victim's behaviour
legal_reference: Duluth 'Minimising, Denying, Blaming'; CPS CC guidance (DARVO recognition)
